title: द्वात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 32 · Duryodhana and Bhima prepare to fight

summary.en: Bhima accepts the challenge and speaks of how he will kill Duryodhana, avenging the wrongs done to Draupadi and the Pandavas. Duryodhana roars back, and the two prepare for the mace fight.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮ ಸವಾಲು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ, ಪಾಂಡವರಿಗಾದ ಅನ್ಯಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇಡು ತೀರಿಸಿ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಕೊಲ್ಲುವೆನೆಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಗರ್ಜಿಸಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಗದಾಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: भीम चुनौती स्वीकार कर बताते हैं कि द्रौपदी और पाण्डवों के प्रति अन्यायों का बदला लेकर वे दुर्योधन को कैसे मारेंगे। दुर्योधन गरजकर उत्तर देता है और दोनों गदायुद्ध की तैयारी करते हैं।
summary.te: భీముడు సవాలు స్వీకరించి ద్రౌపదికి, పాండవులకు జరిగిన అన్యాయాలకు ప్రతీకారంగా దుర్యోధనుని ఎలా చంపుతాడో చెబుతాడు. దుర్యోధనుడు గర్జించి బదులిస్తాడు; ఇద్దరూ గదాయుద్ధానికి సిద్ధమవుతారు.
summary.ta: பீமன் சவாலை ஏற்றுத் திரௌபதிக்கும் பாண்டவருக்கும் இழைத்த அநீதிகளுக்குப் பழிவாங்கித் துரியோதனனை எப்படிக் கொல்வேன் என்கிறான். துரியோதனன் முழங்கிப் பதிலளிக்க, இருவரும் கதைப்போருக்குத் தயாராகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: ഭീമൻ വെല്ലുവിളി സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു; ദ്രൗപദിയോടും പാണ്ഡവരോടും ചെയ്ത അനീതികൾക്ക് പ്രതികാരമായി ദുര്യോധനനെ കൊല്ലുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. ദുര്യോധനൻ തിരിച്ചു ഗർജ്ജിക്കുന്നു; ഇരുവരും ഗദായുദ്ധത്തിന് ഒരുങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.32; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एवं दुर्योधने राजन्गर्जमाने मुहुर्मुहुः ।
युधिष्ठिरस्य संक्रुद्धो वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥

meaning.en: While Duryodhana kept roaring again and again, O king, Vasudeva grew angry and spoke to Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
यदि नाम ह्ययं युद्धे वरयेत्त्वां युधिष्ठिर ।
अर्जुनं नकुलं वापि सहदेवमथापि वा ॥

meaning.en: Krishna said: Yudhishthira, suppose Duryodhana were to choose Arjuna, or Nakula, or Sahadeva, as his opponent in this fight.

verses.text:
किमिदं साहसं राजंस्त्वया व्याहृतमीदृशम् ।
एकमेव निहत्याजौ भव राजा कुरुष्विति ॥

meaning.en: Why, O king, did you utter so rash a thing: "Kill just one of us in battle and be king"?

verses.text:
एतेन हि कृता योग्या वर्षाणीह त्रयोदश ।
आयसे पुरुषे राजन्भीमसेनजिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: For thirteen years this man has trained against an iron figure, wanting to kill Bhimasena.

verses.text:
कथं नाम भवेत्कार्यमस्माभिर्भरतर्षभ ।
साहसं कृतवांस्त्वं तु ह्यनुक्रोशान्नृपोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: O best of the Bharatas, what are we to do now? In your compassion you have done a reckless thing, O best of kings.

verses.text:
नान्यमस्यानुपश्यामि प्रतियोद्धारमाहवे ।
ऋते वृकोदरात्पार्थात्स च नातिकृतश्रमः ॥

meaning.en: I see no other fighter in this battle to match him, except Vrikodara, the son of Pritha, and even he has not trained so hard.

verses.text:
तदिदं द्यूतमारब्धं पुनरेव यथा पुरा ।
विषमं शकुनेश्चैव तव चैव विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: So this is the gambling begun again as before, uneven, between you and Shakuni, O lord of men.

verses.text:
बली भीमः समर्थश्च कृती राजा सुयोधनः ।
बलवान्वा कृती वेति कृती राजन्विशिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: Bhima is strong and capable, but King Suyodhana is the skilled one; between strength and skill, O king, skill is the greater.

verses.text:
सोऽयं राजंस्त्वया शत्रुः समे पथि निवेशितः ।
न्यस्तश्चात्मा सुविषमे कृच्छ्रमापादिता वयम् ॥

meaning.en: You have set this enemy on an even road, O king, while you have staked yourself on a very uneven one, and you have brought us into hardship.

verses.text:
को नु सर्वान्विनिर्जित्य शत्रूनेकेन वैरिणा ।
पणित्वा चैकपाणेन रोचयेदेवमाहवम् ॥

meaning.en: Who, having defeated all his enemies, would stake everything on one opponent and a single contest, and then be pleased with such a fight?

verses.text:
न हि पश्यामि तं लोके गदाहस्तं नरोत्तमम् ।
युध्येद्दुर्योधनं संख्ये कृतित्वाद्धि विशेषयेत् ॥

meaning.en: I do not see anyone in the world, mace in hand, who could fight Duryodhana in battle, for his skill sets him above others.

verses.text:
फल्गुनं वा भवन्तं वा माद्रीपुत्रावथापि वा ।
न समर्थानहं मन्ये गदाहस्तस्य संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Neither Arjuna, nor you, nor the two sons of Madri, do I think a match for him in a mace-fight.

verses.text:
स कथं वदसे शत्रुं युध्यस्व गदयेति ह ।
एकं च नो निहत्याजौ भव राजेति भारत ॥

meaning.en: So how can you tell your enemy, "Fight with the mace, and if you kill one of us, be king," Bharata?

verses.text:
वृकोदरं समासाद्य संशयो विजये हि नः ।
न्यायतो युध्यमानानां कृती ह्येष महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Facing Vrikodara, our victory is in doubt: even when fighting fairly, this mighty man is the skilled one.

verses.text: भीम उवाच

meaning.en: Bhima said:

verses.text:
मधुसूदन मा कार्षीर्विषादं यदुनन्दन ।
अद्य पारं गमिष्यामि वैरस्य भृशदुर्गमम् ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, delight of the Yadavas, do not grieve. Today I will cross to the far shore of this enmity, so hard to cross.

verses.text:
अहं सुयोधनं संख्ये हनिष्यामि न संशयः ।
विजयो वै ध्रुवं कृष्ण धर्मराजस्य दृश्यते ॥

meaning.en: I will kill Suyodhana in battle, without doubt. Victory, Krishna, surely lies with the king of dharma.

verses.text:
अध्यर्धेन गुणेनेयं गदा गुरुतरी मम ।
न तथा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य मा कार्षीर्माधव व्यथाम् ॥

meaning.en: My mace is half as heavy again as the son of Dhritarashtra's; do not worry, Madhava.

verses.text:
सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीन्नानाशस्त्रधरान्युधि ।
योधयेयं रणे हृष्टः किमुताद्य सुयोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: I would gladly fight the three worlds with the gods, wielding every kind of weapon, in battle; how much more Suyodhana today!

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तथा संभाषमाणं तु वासुदेवो वृकोदरम् ।
हृष्टः संपूजयामास वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: As Bhima spoke thus, Vasudeva was pleased and honoured him, and said these words.

verses.text:
त्वामाश्रित्य महाबाहो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
निहतारिः स्वकां दीप्तां श्रियं प्राप्तो न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Relying on you, mighty-armed one, Yudhishthira the king of dharma, with his foes slain, has won his own blazing fortune, without doubt.

verses.text:
त्वया विनिहताः सर्वे धृतराष्ट्रसुता रणे ।
राजानो राजपुत्राश्च नागाश्च विनिपातिताः ॥

meaning.en: By you all the sons of Dhritarashtra have been killed in battle, and kings, princes and elephants laid low.

verses.text:
कलिङ्गा मागधाः प्राच्या गान्धाराः कुरवस्तथा ।
त्वामासाद्य महायुद्धे निहताः पाण्डुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: The Kalingas, Magadhas, Easterners, Gandharas and Kurus all met you in the great war and were slain, son of Pandu.

verses.text:
हत्वा दुर्योधनं चापि प्रयच्छोर्वीं ससागराम् ।
धर्मराजाय कौन्तेय यथा विष्णुः शचीपतेः ॥

meaning.en: Once you have killed Duryodhana, give the earth with its oceans to the king of dharma, son of Kunti, as Vishnu gave it to the lord of Shachi.

verses.text:
त्वां च प्राप्य रणे पापो धार्तराष्ट्रो विनङ्क्ष्यति ।
त्वमस्य सक्थिनी भङ्क्त्वा प्रतिज्ञां पारयिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Meeting you in battle, the wicked son of Dhritarashtra will perish; you will break his thighs and fulfil your vow.

verses.text:
यत्नेन तु सदा पार्थ योद्धव्यो धृतराष्ट्रजः ।
कृती च बलवांश्चैव युद्धशौण्डश्च नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: Still, Partha, you must always fight the son of Dhritarashtra with care, for he is skilled, strong and ever eager for battle.

verses.text:
ततस्तु सात्यकी राजन्पूजयामास पाण्डवम् ।
विविधाभिश्च तां वाग्भिः पूजयामास माधवः ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, O king, honoured the Pandava, and Madhava honoured him with many kinds of words too.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवेयाश्च धर्मराजपुरोगमाः ।
तद्वचो भीमसेनस्य सर्व एवाभ्यपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: The Panchalas and the Pandavas, with the king of dharma at their head, all praised those words of Bhimasena.

verses.text:
ततो भीमबलो भीमो युधिष्ठिरमथाब्रवीत् ।
सृञ्जयैः सह तिष्ठन्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, terrible in strength, spoke to Yudhishthira, who stood among the Srinjayas like the blazing sun.

verses.text:
अहमेतेन संगम्य संयुगे योद्धुमुत्सहे ।
न हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं मामेष पुरुषाधमः ॥

meaning.en: I am ready to meet him in battle and fight; this lowest of men cannot defeat me in the fight.

verses.text:
अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि निहितं हृदये भृशम् ।
सुयोधने धार्तराष्ट्रे खाण्डवेऽग्निमिवार्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: Today I will release the anger stored deep in my heart against Dhritarashtra's son Suyodhana, as Arjuna loosed fire on Khandava.

verses.text:
शल्यमद्योद्धरिष्यामि तव पाण्डव हृच्छयम् ।
निहत्य गदया पापमद्य राजन्सुखी भव ॥

meaning.en: Today, Pandava, I will pull out the dart lodged in your heart; having killed the wicked one with my mace, be happy today, O king.

verses.text:
अद्य कीर्तिमयीं मालां प्रतिमोक्ष्ये तवानघ ।
प्राणाञ्श्रियं च राज्यं च मोक्ष्यतेऽद्य सुयोधनः ॥

meaning.en: Today, blameless one, I will tie the garland of fame about you; today Suyodhana will lose his life, his fortune and his kingdom.

verses.text:
राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य श्रुत्वा पुत्रं मया हतम् ।
स्मरिष्यत्यशुभं कर्म यत्तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम् ॥

meaning.en: And King Dhritarashtra, hearing today that I have killed his son, will remember the evil deed born of Shakuni's counsel.

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् ।
उदतिष्ठत युद्धाय शक्रो वृत्रमिवाह्वयन् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the mighty best of the Bharatas raised his mace and stood up to fight, like Indra challenging Vritra.

verses.text:
तमेकाकिनमासाद्य धार्तराष्ट्रं महाबलम् ।
निर्यूथमिव मातङ्गं समहृष्यन्त पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the great-armed son of Dhritarashtra standing alone like a herd-less elephant, the Pandavas rejoiced.

verses.text:
तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम् ।
भीमसेनस्तदा राजन्दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him with raised mace like the peaked Kailasa, Bhimasena then spoke to Duryodhana, O king.

verses.text:
राज्ञापि धृतराष्ट्रेण त्वया चास्मासु यत्कृतम् ।
स्मर तद्दुष्कृतं कर्म यद्वृत्तं वारणावते ॥

meaning.en: Remember the wrong done to us by King Dhritarashtra and by you, the deed done at Varanavata.

verses.text:
द्रौपदी च परिक्लिष्टा सभामध्ये रजस्वला ।
द्यूते यद्विजितो राजा शकुनेर्बुद्धिनिश्चयात् ॥

meaning.en: Remember Draupadi, in her season, tormented in the midst of the assembly, and the king defeated at dice by Shakuni's design.

verses.text:
यानि चान्यानि दुष्टात्मन्पापानि कृतवानसि ।
अनागःसु च पार्थेषु तस्य पश्य महत्फलम् ॥

meaning.en: And all the other sins you committed, wicked one, against the blameless sons of Pritha: see now their great fruit.

verses.text:
त्वत्कृते निहतः शेते शरतल्पे महायशाः ।
गाङ्गेयो भरतश्रेष्ठः सर्वेषां नः पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Because of you the glorious Gangeya, best of the Bharatas, grandsire of us all, lies on a bed of arrows.

verses.text:
हतो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च हतः शल्यः प्रतापवान् ।
वैरस्य चादिकर्तासौ शकुनिर्निहतो युधि ॥

meaning.en: Drona is slain, and Karna, and the mighty Shalya; Shakuni, who began this enmity, has been killed in battle.

verses.text:
भ्रातरस्ते हताः शूराः पुत्राश्च सहसैनिकाः ।
राजानश्च हताः शूराः समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः ॥

meaning.en: Your brothers, the heroes, are dead, and your sons with their troops, and the kings who never turned back from battle.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च निहता बहवः क्षत्रियर्षभाः ।
प्रातिकामी तथा पापो द्रौपद्याः क्लेशकृद्धतः ॥

meaning.en: These and many other bull-like Kshatriyas are slain, and the wicked Pratikamin who tormented Draupadi is dead.

verses.text:
अवशिष्टस्त्वमेवैकः कुलघ्नोऽधमपूरुषः ।
त्वामप्यद्य हनिष्यामि गदया नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: You alone remain, destroyer of your family, lowest of men; today I will kill you too with my mace, there is no doubt.

verses.text:
अद्य तेऽहं रणे दर्पं सर्वं नाशयिता नृप ।
राज्याशां विपुलां राजन्पाण्डवेषु च दुष्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Today, O king, I will destroy all your pride in battle, your vast hope of the kingdom, and your wickedness toward the Pandavas.

verses.text: दुर्योधन उवाच

meaning.en: Duryodhana said:

verses.text:
किं कत्थितेन बहुधा युध्यस्वाद्य मया सह ।
अद्य तेऽहं विनेष्यामि युद्धश्रद्धां वृकोदर ॥

meaning.en: Why boast so much? Fight me today. Today, Vrikodara, I will drive your longing for battle out of you.

verses.text:
किं न पश्यसि मां पाप गदायुद्धे व्यवस्थितम् ।
हिमवच्छिखराकारां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम् ॥

meaning.en: Do you not see me, wicked one, standing ready in the mace-fight, holding a great mace like a peak of the Himalaya?

verses.text:
गदिनं कोऽद्य मां पाप जेतुमुत्सहते रिपुः ।
न्यायतो युध्यमानस्य देवेष्वपि पुरंदरः ॥

meaning.en: What enemy, wretch, dares to conquer me, mace in hand? If I fight fairly, not even Indra among the gods could.

verses.text:
मा वृथा गर्ज कौन्तेय शारदाभ्रमिवाजलम् ।
दर्शयस्व बलं युद्धे यावत्तत्तेऽद्य विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Do not roar in vain, son of Kunti, like an autumn cloud without water. Show your strength in battle, as much of it as you have today.

verses.text:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पाञ्चालाः सहसृञ्जयाः ।
सर्वे संपूजयामासुस्तद्वचो विजिगीषवः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, the Panchalas and Srinjayas, all eager for victory, applauded them.

verses.text:
तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं तलशब्देन मानवाः ।
भूयः संहर्षयामासू राजन्दुर्योधनं नृपम् ॥

meaning.en: The men, clapping their hands, cheered King Duryodhana again, like a rutting elephant.

verses.text:
बृंहन्ति कुञ्जरास्तत्र हया हेषन्ति चासकृत् ।
शस्त्राणि संप्रदीप्यन्ते पाण्डवानां जयैषिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Elephants trumpeted there, horses neighed again and again, and the weapons of the victory-seeking Pandavas flashed.
